propositions: Overlap judge calls inherit unconstrained generic 16,000-token, three-generation, four-transport-attempt, and 600-second budgets, causing multi-minute malformed JSON responses and multiple retries before safe abstention
Token limits alone do not prevent retried structured generations; schema validation alone cannot prevent oversized payloads from being constructed and transmitted

RunRequest budget contract now includes lowering-only per-request seams for structured-output retries, transport attempts, and request timeout that flow through _effective_config before model/provider construction
Overlap judge requests are bounded to 1,024 output tokens, one structured generation, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout; any bound triggers logged safe all-candidate abstention
Valid batched overlap verdicts retain label-keyed mapping and aggregation behavior; callers omitting request-local limits retain current defaults
